# pdqsort in Fates

Fates vendors the upstream single-header `pdqsort` implementation for serial
candidate sorting.

- Upstream: https://github.com/orlp/pdqsort
- Revision: `b1ef26a55cdb60d236a5cb199c4234c704f46726`
- Header SHA-256: `1916aff237fc7ecc638dec6397662334552a1b6f823fa65011a8dfe831237fc0`
- License: zlib, preserved in `LICENSE`

The vendored header and license are unmodified.
